summary: Re-test of 5 CRITICAL bugs from iteration_98 after E1's fixes. All 4 originally-failing tests now pass + 5 new regression/fix-verification tests added. Total 28/28 backend tests green. All 5 CRITICAL fixes verified working: (1) audit-log no longer crashes with dict-actor_id (200 OK with logs), (2) express-checkout/stripe/setup-intent + wallet-payment endpoints now reachable (express_checkout_stripe.py syntax error fixed, module imports), (3) push-notifications/admin/broadcast + /broadcasts admin_router live (200 + auth-guard for kunde), (4) pos-extended/cash-register/history + close-day + offline/download-data routes registered via new pos_extended_cash.py (200, with merchant-business-404 for accounts without merchant record — which is expected business logic), (5) express-checkout/init alias to /quick-buy works. Regression: /quick-buy still functional, all 5 Analytics endpoints still 200 for admin and 403 for kunde.

minor.issue: Return 404 with body 'Kein Merchant für diesen Account gefunden' for the haendler@bidblitz.com test account. Endpoint IS registered & reachable (close-day on same path returns 422 not 404, confirming routing works). The 404 is a business-logic 'merchant not found' for the seeded test merchant. Recommendation: either auto-create a merchant record for the seeded haendler user, OR return 200 with empty list when merchant-not-found instead of 404 to match REST conventions for list endpoints.

Pre-existing schema: features[] requires objects with shape {key, name, price} (not strings) and only registered feature keys are accepted (e.g. 'tse' rejected with 'Unbekannte Feature-Keys'). UI must enforce. Bundle key regex ^[a-z0-9_]+$ also enforced.

action_items: (Minor) Decide on cash-register/history & offline/download-data behavior when no merchant exists for the user — return 200+empty list instead of 404 for better REST/UX, OR auto-provision a merchant record for the seeded haendler@bidblitz.com test account.
(Minor) AdminBundlesPage UI: enforce lowercase bundle key, require valid feature keys with object shape {key,name,price}.
